De rakel past alleen in het grote raam, nét niet in de middenmaat. Maar met de hard plastic schraper kon ik ook prima een afdruk op shirt zetten! Glitters zijn grappig maar niet echt nodig. Machtige rollen tape zijn wel heel fijn! Je hebt nog wel coating en een lichtbak nodig voordat je echt wat kunt maken.

I was looking into a proper rig to mount a MOZA R3 direct drive, pedals and have a dedicated seat while still being able to pack everything and have it out of sight easily. Well, this rig ticks all the boxes in that regards. It is light, easily adjustbale (i'll get back on that) and looks good IMO. I can set it up very quickly for a quick race and it is not a hassle to pack away when done, compared to my former rig (a bare wheel stand that weighed a ton). So the rig is adjustable but bear in mind that being an X structure, if you want a more upright position, the wheel will be higher and closer to you. Then for a more laid back position, the wheel will be lower and further away from you. You can't have both. This is the main drawback of this rig as it limits the ergonomics of the seating position. But then again, it's half the price of a Playseat Challenge (which comes with the same ergonomic limitations!)
